How to keep your towels soft, fluffy and fresh 🧺✨

Wash towels in their own load, add baking soda to help freshen them, and swap fabric softener for white vinegar. Go easy on detergent, too much can leave residue behind, so use the right amount and a good-quality detergent.

Wash warm, tumble dry on low, and make sure towels are fully dry before storing. I also like washing bath towels every 3–4 uses to keep them fresh.
